name: Docker Skills
summary: Official Docker Agent Skills for Dockerfiles, Compose, Docker Sandboxes, and Docker Agent. Apache-2.0 pack in docker/skills; live Docker usage is billed separately.
description: Vendor-affiliated listing (Docker). The docker/skills repository is Apache-2.0, not archived, and was pushed 2026-11-13. The pack is free to install. Paid Docker product usage (Hub, cloud, Sandboxes compute) is separate and was not purchased. Official docs at https://docs.docker.com/ai/skills/ and the install page at https://docs.docker.com/ai/skills/install/ (both HTTP 200; https://docs.docker.com/ai/skills.md is also 200). Documented installs were not executed: `npx skills add docker/skills` (variants include --list, --skill, --all, --yes, -g); Claude Code `/plugin marketplace add docker/skills` then the docker-skills@docker plugin; Codex `codex plugin add docker-skills@docker`; and `gemini extensions install https://github.com/docker/skills`. Plugin and extension installs also register a remote Docker docs MCP at https://ai-backend-service.docker.com/mcp, used by the docker-docs skill. That host was not probed and this entry does not set mcp_endpoint. Skills cover Dockerfile and image builds, Compose, Docker Sandboxes (isolated code execution; see docker-sandboxes), and Docker Agent. Docs say to review proposed changes and confirm destructive operations. No signup or spend.
